harness.name: omp
harness.description: omp (oh-my-pi) coding harness, with any provider it signs in to.

files.content:
// Discobox's hooks for omp, installed with the image. Removing this file stops them.
export { default } from "/usr/local/libexec/discobox/omp-hook-extension.js";

config.reminder: Sign in with /login, pick a default model with /model, then finish configuration with /exit.
